features.label: Simplified shapes
features.explanation: Simplify existing forms into simple shapes with varied sizes and directions
features.evidence: The house, treetops and figure are composed of simple large shapes, with varied sizes and angles.
features.zh: 将原有形体概括为有大小和方向变化的简单形状
features.en: Simplify existing forms into simple shapes with varied sizes and directions

features.label: Shape in place of line
features.explanation: Define forms mainly through boundaries between adjacent color fields, reducing uniform outlines
features.evidence: Many forms are distinguished by adjacent color shapes, without a uniform black outline.
features.zh: 主要用相邻色面的边界界定形体，减少统一描边
features.en: Define forms mainly through boundaries between adjacent color fields, reducing uniform outlines

features.label: Bold warm–cool contrast
features.explanation: Set bright yellow-green against deep blue and violet to establish clear warm–cool and value contrasts
features.evidence: The house’s yellow-green light areas are surrounded by blue-violet woods, concentrating warm–cool and value contrasts.
features.zh: 以深蓝紫承托黄绿亮色，建立明确的冷暖与明度对比
features.en: Set bright yellow-green against deep blue and violet to establish clear warm–cool and value contrasts

features.label: Light through color shapes
features.explanation: Express light through light and dark color shapes, avoiding naturalistic optical reflections
features.evidence: The sense of light comes from the contrast between the bright house and dark setting, rather than uniform naturalistic shadows.
features.zh: 以明暗色块表达光感，避免写实的光学反射
features.en: Express light through light and dark color shapes, avoiding naturalistic optical reflections

features.label: Layered space
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s front-to-back relationships, using overlap and shape size to build layered space
features.evidence: Foreground tree trunks and leaf shapes overlap the middle ground, opening up the space at the center.
features.zh: 保留原图前后关系，用遮挡和形状大小建立层叠空间
features.en: Keep the source image’s front-to-back relationships, using overlap and shape size to build layered space

features.label: Hand-painted color fields
features.explanation: Retain subtle brushwork and irregular edges in opaque, hand-painted color fields
features.evidence: The color fields have slightly irregular edges and visible hand-painted variation; the image index used does not specify materials.
features.zh: 保留不透明手绘色面的轻微笔触与不规则边缘
features.en: Retain subtle brushwork and irregular edges in opaque, hand-painted color fields

features.label: Fairy-tale vitality
features.explanation: Create an imaginative, light and lively narrative atmosphere
features.evidence: Tilted shapes with unusual proportions combine with bold colors to create a fairy-tale vitality.
features.zh: 营造富于想象、轻盈而有活力的叙事氛围
features.en: Create an imaginative, light and lively narrative atmosphere

features.label: Keep the source palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creating an image, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑或道具；不添加参考图的题字、署名或水印；不改变原图的动作与物件关系
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings or props absent from the source image; do not add inscriptions, signatures or watermarks from the reference; do not alter the source image’s actions or relationships between objects
